title: erysimum maculatum
intro: Erysimum maculatum, commonly known as Wavyleaf Wallflower or Spotted Wallflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Erysimum maculatum include its ability to act as a demulcent, protecting mucous membranes, and a vulnerary, promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Erysimum maculatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
